$comment: The tier fork: what a Peer seat on claude-peer is about to start on. The labels are the tiers room/models.json lists on that provider, with what each is for. expect: the tier that fits. Cases whose id starts with held- are kept out of tuning the question.

cases.title: Rename getUser to fetchUser across the code base
cases.brief: Mechanical rename in 14 files; no change of behavior; update the imports.

cases.title: Fix typos in the docs
cases.brief: Fix the spelling errors listed in the issue in docs/*.md.

cases.title: Add pagination to the orders API
cases.brief: Add cursor pagination to GET /orders, keep the old offset parameter working, and update the tests.

cases.title: Debug the flaky checkout test
cases.brief: checkout.test.ts fails one run in ten; find out why and fix it.

cases.title: Design how offline edits merge
cases.brief: Propose how offline edits on mobile merge with web edits; compare a CRDT with last-write-wins and write down the trade-offs and the choice.

cases.title: Format the SQL files
cases.brief: Run the formatter on db/*.sql and commit the result.

cases.title: Retry failed webhooks
cases.brief: Retry failed webhooks with backoff up to five times, store the attempts, and add tests.

cases.title: Test scaffolds for the billing module
cases.brief: Create empty test files with a describe block for each exported function in src/billing/.

cases.title: Find where the user cache goes stale
cases.brief: Find every place the user cache is invalidated and write down when a stale read is possible.

cases.title: Is the lock-free queue correct?
cases.brief: Decide whether the queue in src/queue/ring.ts can lose an item under two producers, and argue it step by step.

cases.title: Third lens on the payment refactor
cases.brief: Two lenses disagree on whether the new payment state machine can charge twice. Read the candidate and settle it.

cases.title: Write the changelog entry
cases.brief: Add an entry to CHANGELOG.md for the 2.3.0 release from the merged pull request titles.

cases.title: Update the copyright year
cases.brief: Change 2025 to 2026 in the header comment of every file under src/.

cases.title: Validate CSV imports
cases.brief: Check each row of an import against the schema, report bad rows with their line numbers, and add tests.

cases.title: Choose the audit trail design
cases.brief: Decide between an append-only event log and snapshot tables for the audit trail; weigh replay cost against storage and write down the decision.

cases.title: Rename the database variable
cases.brief: Rename DB_URL to DATABASE_URL in the code, the docs and the example env file.

cases.title: Fix the worker's memory leak
cases.brief: The worker's memory grows by 50 MB an hour; find the leak and fix it, with a test.

cases.title: Can the retry charge twice?
cases.brief: Argue whether the payment retry can charge a card twice when the provider times out after charging: find the case, or show why it cannot happen.

cases.title: Sort the imports
cases.brief: Run the import sorter over src/ and commit the result.

cases.title: Find out how sessions expire
cases.brief: Read the session code and write down when a session expires and what renews it.
